# MatchLine { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchLine }

```python
alignment.MatchLine(source_timeline_id, stamps=list())
```

Ordered sequence of MatchStamps for a source timeline.

A MatchLine collects all synchronised timestamps that mention a
given *source* timeline, orders them by coordinate on that timeline,
and exposes ``get_coordinate_pairs()`` to extract the
``(source_coord, target_coord)`` table consumed by WarpMap.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name               | Type                                                                     | Description                                                       |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| source_timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                             | The timeline whose coordinates define the ordering of the stamps. |
| stamps             | [list](`list`)\[[MatchStamp](`timetoalign.alignment.graph.MatchStamp`)\] | MatchStamps sorted by coordinate on ``source_timeline_id``.       |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> line = MatchLine.from_claims(
...     claims=claims,
...     source_timeline_id="score",
... )
>>> pairs = line.get_coordinate_pairs("audio")
>>> pairs
[(0.0, 0.0), (100.0, 45.5), (200.0, 91.0)]
```

### from_claims { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchLine.from_claims }

```python
alignment.MatchLine.from_claims(
    claims,
    source_timeline_id,
    *,
    groups=None,
    timeline_to_group=None,
    timeline_ids=None,
    id_pattern=None,
    include_domains=None,
    include_units=None,
)
```

Build a MatchLine from claims via a MatchGraph.

Constructs a MatchGraph from the supplied claims, optionally
extends it to groups, extracts MatchStamps, and orders them by
coordinate on the source timeline.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                                                                  | Description                                                                                      | Default    |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| claims             | [list](`list`)\[[MatchClaim](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchClaim`)\]                             | List of MatchClaims to resolve.                                                                  | _required_ |
| source_timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                                                          | The timeline whose coordinates define the ordering.                                              | _required_ |
| groups             | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [TimelineGroup](`timetoalign.timelines.groups.TimelineGroup`)\] \| None | Dict of group_id -> TimelineGroup for group extension. If None, no group extension is performed. | `None`     |
| timeline_to_group  | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\] \| None                                                  | Dict of timeline_id -> group_id.  Required if ``groups`` is provided.                            | `None`     |
| timeline_ids       | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None                                                                  | Only extend to these timeline IDs.                                                               | `None`     |
| id_pattern         | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                  | Regex filter for timeline IDs.                                                                   | `None`     |
| include_domains    | [set](`set`)\[[Domain](`timetoalign.core.enums.Domain`)\] \| None                                     | Only extend to timelines in these domains.                                                       | `None`     |
| include_units      | [set](`set`)\[[TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)\] \| None                                 | Only extend to timelines with these units.                                                       | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                     | Description                                          |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [MatchLine](`timetoalign.alignment.matchline.MatchLine`) | A MatchLine with stamps sorted by source coordinate. |

### from_graphs { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchLine.from_graphs }

```python
alignment.MatchLine.from_graphs(graphs, source_timeline_id)
```

Build a MatchLine from multiple MatchGraphs.

Merges MatchStamps from several MatchGraphs (the Hendrix M6-M9
pattern) into a single ordered sequence. Duplicate stamps
(same source coordinate) are deduplicated, keeping the stamp
with the most timelines.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                                     | Description                                         | Default    |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| graphs             | [list](`list`)\[[MatchGraph](`timetoalign.alignment.graph.MatchGraph`)\] | List of MatchGraphs to merge.                       | _required_ |
| source_timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                             | The timeline whose coordinates define the ordering. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                     | Description                                            |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [MatchLine](`timetoalign.alignment.matchline.MatchLine`) | A MatchLine with merged, deduplicated stamps sorted by |
|        | [MatchLine](`timetoalign.alignment.matchline.MatchLine`) | source coordinate.                                     |

### get_coordinate_pairs { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchLine.get_coordinate_pairs }

```python
alignment.MatchLine.get_coordinate_pairs(target_timeline_id)
```

Extract (source_coord, target_coord) pairs for a target timeline.

Only stamps that contain both the source and target timelines
contribute to the result. Pairs are ordered by source coordinate.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type         | Description                                     | Default    |
|--------------------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| target_timeline_id | [str](`str`) | The timeline to extract target coordinates for. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                     | Description                                                |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[tuple](`tuple`)\[[float](`float`), [float](`float`)\]\] | List of ``(source_coord, target_coord)`` tuples, sorted by |
|        | [list](`list`)\[[tuple](`tuple`)\[[float](`float`), [float](`float`)\]\] | source coordinate.                                         |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                              |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If ``target_timeline_id`` equals ``source_timeline_id``. |

### save_as { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchLine.save_as }

```python
alignment.MatchLine.save_as(filepath, *, format='match', context=None)
```

Export this MatchLine to a file.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                                                                                                        | Default    |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| filepath | [str](`str`) \| [Path](`pathlib.Path`)                                            | Output file path.  If the extension matches a known format, the format is inferred (e.g. ``.match``).                                                              | _required_ |
| format   | [str](`str`)                                                                      | Export format.  Currently supported: ``"match"``.                                                                                                                  | `'match'`  |
| context  | [MatchFileContext](`timetoalign.alignment.match_format.MatchFileContext`) \| None | Supplementary data for format-specific fields. Required for full ``.match`` export; if ``None``, a minimal file with coordinate-only placeholder data is produced. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                   | Description               |
|--------|------------------------|---------------------------|
|        | [Path](`pathlib.Path`) | The resolved output path. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                     |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the format is not supported. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> line.save_as("output.match")  # minimal placeholder export
>>> line.save_as("output.match", context=ctx)  # rich export
```

### target_timeline_ids { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchLine.target_timeline_ids }

```python
alignment.MatchLine.target_timeline_ids()
```

All target timelines appearing in at least 2 stamps.

A target timeline must appear in at least two stamps for
interpolation (i.e., WarpMap construction) to be meaningful.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                         | Description                                            |
|--------|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] | Set of timeline IDs (excluding the source) that appear |
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] | in >= 2 stamps.                                        |
